cards.title: Choose stack and scaffold project
cards.notes: Decide server, database, and PWA setup. Produce a running Docker container with a hello page.

cards.title: Items: habits and chores CRUD
cards.notes:
Name, icon, color, points. Habit schedules: daily, weekdays, N per week. Chore schedule: every N days since last done.

Schedule JSON shapes: docs/data-model.md.

cards.title: Today view with one-tap check-off
cards.notes: List of items due today, overdue chores on top. Tap toggles done. Optional note.

cards.title: Points ledger and daily bonus
cards.notes:
Each completion earns its points. +5 when everything due today is done. Ledger per day.

See docs/data-model.md (ledger). Write the ledger row on each check-in change, do not recompute.

cards.title: Reward goal with progress
cards.notes: One active goal: name, target, picture. Progress bar, pace estimate, redeem with reset or carry over.

cards.title: Streaks, strength score, heatmap
cards.notes:
Current and best streak per habit. Loop-style strength score. Per-item calendar heatmap.

Score formula: docs/research.md section 1 (Loop exponential smoothing). Chores get dueness instead of a score.

cards.title: PWA: install, offline, sync
cards.notes: Manifest, service worker, offline check-offs queued in an IndexedDB outbox and replayed from the page on reconnect. docs/research.md section 5.

cards.title: Push reminders
cards.notes: Per-item reminder time. Standard Web Push with VAPID and a service worker push handler. Android Chrome only. docs/research.md section 4.

cards.title: Single-user login
cards.notes: One password from environment. Session cookie.

cards.title: Export to JSON
cards.notes: Dump all items, check-ins, ledger, goals.

cards.title: Coolify deployment
cards.notes:
Dockerfile, persistent volume for the database, environment documented in .env.example.

SQLite on named volume at /app/data, non-root user. docs/research.md section 7.

cards.title: Dates module: one place for day boundaries
cards.notes: Single module that turns a UTC instant into local_date using the timezone setting, and lists which items are due on a date. Nothing else does date maths. docs/research.md section 6.

cards.title: Chore dueness and Today sort order
cards.notes: dueness = daysSinceLastDone / intervalDays. Overdue chores first, then due habits, then done items. Show a green-to-red hint per chore.

cards.title: Home screen badge with count due
cards.notes: Badging API on installed app: set badge to number of items still due today, clear at zero.

cards.title: Reminder scheduler on the server
cards.notes: Every minute, find items whose reminder_time matches now in the user's timezone and are still not done, send one push per item.

cards.title: Settings page
cards.notes: Timezone, daily bonus value, password change, push subscribe button, export link.

cards.title: Archive items instead of deleting
cards.notes: archived_at keeps history and ledger intact. Archived items hidden from Today.

cards.title: Undo a check-off
cards.notes: Tap again within the day removes the check-in and rewrites that day's ledger row.
